********************************** AI_master_workflow ******************************

以下简要教程基于Windows 10系统。

1.建议：提前复制一个半完整的ComfyUI工作目录（不需要复制models文件夹及其内容），方便后续安装musev时搭建更适合本项目需求的虚拟环境和相关依赖。

2. 导入此工作流程并使用新复制的 comfyui 包中的管理器节点安装缺少的 musev 节点。

3、下载对应的模型，放到models\diffusers文件夹下（需要32G左右硬盘空间）。具体方法如下：

在新建的comfyui目录的地址栏中输入“cmd”或“powershell”命令，然后复制以下命令运行：

Huggingface-cli 下载 --resume-download TMElyralab/MuseV --local-dir models/diffusers/TMElyralab/MuseV

4.如果模型下载成功，您可以在models\diffusers文件夹中看到TMElyralab/MuseV文件夹及其内部模型。

5.基于节点：https://github.com/chaojie/ComfyUI-MuseV

6.工作流程自带视频插帧功能，可将视频帧率提升至24fps以上。

********************************** AI_master_workflow ******************************

********************************* AI_master_workflow *****************************

The following brief tutorial is based on the Windows 10 system.

1. Suggestion: Copy a semi-complete ComfyUI working directory in advance (there is no need to copy the models folder and its contents) to facilitate the construction of a virtual environment and related dependencies that are more suitable for the requirements of this project when musev is installed later.

2. Import this workflow and install the missing musev node using the manager node in the newly copied comfyui package.

3. Download the corresponding model and put it in the models\diffusers folder (about 32G hard disk space is required). The specific method is as follows:

In the address bar of the new comfyui directory, enter the "cmd" or "powershell" command, and then copy the following command to run:

huggingface-cli download --resume-download TMElyralab/MuseV --local-dir models/diffusers/TMElyralab/MuseV

4. If the model is downloaded successfully, you can see the TMElyralab/MuseV folder and its internal models in the models\diffusers folder.

5.Based on node:https://github.com/chaojie/ComfyUI-MuseV

6.The workflow comes with video frame interpolation, which can upgrade the video to a frame rate of 24fps or above.

********************************* AI_master_workflow *****************************
